gui.industrial_core.atlas.title: Species Atlas
gui.industrial_core.atlas.intro: Every nanite species is collected here. A species opens when its strain gets into your inventory, together with its best record. Records earn medals: bronze, silver and gold by the share of the class cap.
gui.industrial_core.atlas.rare_tip: Rare species are not bred directly: they appear on their own when selection runs under special conditions.
gui.industrial_core.atlas.how.miner: Evolved in the Evolution Chamber on ore or raw ore: %s. Goes into the Industrial Miner.
gui.industrial_core.atlas.how.processor: Evolved in the Evolution Chamber on dust: %s. Goes into the Ore Washer.
gui.industrial_core.atlas.how.scientist: Evolved in the Evolution Chamber on a sample of the theme «%s». Works in the Nanite Lab.
nanite_trait.industrial_core.cryophile.h: A swarm grown in the cold stops fearing the heat.
Appears after 20 generations in the cold: the chamber stands right next to a cryo block.
nanite_trait.industrial_core.cryophile.e: Heat in the chamber no longer lowers stability.
nanite_trait.industrial_core.pyronite.hi: The flame lets through only those who reached the limit without falling apart.
nanite_trait.industrial_core.pyronite.ho: Appears when the strain reaches its cap in a chamber heated above 90%, with stability of 50% or more, after 20 hot generations.
nanite_trait.industrial_core.resonator.h: The fields of a big machine change how the swarm hears the ore.
Appears after 20 generations in a field: an Electromagnet Core within 8 blocks of the chamber.
nanite_trait.industrial_core.resonator.e: 15% chance that the effect works twice.
nanite_trait.industrial_core.chimera.hin: Whoever does not choose one gets a bit of everything.
nanite_trait.industrial_core.chimera.how: Appears when the strain holds a quarter of its cap for three targets at once.
nanite_trait.industrial_core.chimera.eff: On a foreign target it works at half of its best affinity.
nanite_trait.industrial_core.self_assemb: A long calm without a single mistake.
Appears after 100 generations in a row at full stability.
